title: Good in All Things?
question: For whom, and toward what end, does God work all things together for good?
blurb: A promise with an address: trace who it's for and the purpose it's aiming at.

nodes.content: For whom, and toward what end, does God work all things together for good?

nodes.verseText: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.

nodes.content: The promise is addressed: it is for "those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose" - not a blanket guarantee that every outcome will feel good, but that God bends all things toward good for His people.

nodes.verseText: For those God foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, so that He would be the firstborn among many brothers.
As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.
What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

nodes.content: "All things" includes the suffering Paul has just been describing (8:18) - he is not denying hardship but saying nothing falls outside God's good purpose for His own.
